summary: Phase 81.31 Checkbox Label & Radio Group Collapsing - Code Review Verification Complete. All Phase 81.31 features verified via code review: (1) fieldDisplayLabel() now prefers field.label over field.checkboxLabel for checkboxes, (2) groupAssignableFields() collapses sibling radio fields into ONE row per groupName, (3) assignRadioGroup() writes same recipient to all sibling field IDs, (4) radioGroupAssignment() returns consolidated recipient, (5) assignmentStats counts radio groups as 1 row each, (6) Panel render uses isGroup branching for 'Radio Group: <groupName>' display. UI smoke test confirmed Generate Document wizard loads correctly but test template has no checkbox/radio fields to visually verify the Assign Fields panel.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 81.31 checkbox label fix and radio group collapsing verified via code review. The test environment has 2 'Reminder Test Template' templates but neither has checkbox/radio field placements. To fully test the UI flow with visual verification, create a template with checkbox and radio fields using the Visual Builder (drag checkbox, set label to 'All of my medical records', drag radio group with multiple options), then run the Generate Document wizard with two recipients. The Assign Fields panel should show: (1) Checkbox row with user-set label instead of 'Check to agree', (2) Radio group as ONE row labeled 'Radio Group: <groupName>' with 'radio group · N options' type indicator.
